finding.title: Desynchronized aria-invalid and aria-describedby with :user-invalid
finding.description: Form inputs rely on CSS :user-invalid and setCustomValidity() without syncing programmatic aria-invalid state. Inputs omit initial aria-invalid="false" (causing Firefox and Safari to expose empty required fields as invalid on page load, and Chromium not to expose them as invalid after interaction). Error elements are statically referenced in aria-describedby in HTML markup rather than linked only when visible. On server validation failure, auth.form.ts does not move focus to the first invalid field.
finding.remediation: Initialize form controls with aria-invalid="false", synchronize aria-invalid="true"/"false" and aria-describedby error IDs on blur/change/input/invalid/reset events, announce field errors via a single polite live region, and move focus to the first invalid field when server validation fails.

finding.title: IME-unsafe Enter-to-submit handler in Safari
finding.description: The composer keydown handler checks only !event.isComposing before submitting on Enter. In Safari (WebKit bug 165004), compositionend fires before the confirming Enter keydown event, resetting event.isComposing to false and causing incomplete IME text to be submitted prematurely.
finding.remediation: Call event.preventDefault() when event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey, then return early if event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229 (or use a 50ms event.timeStamp window against compositionend).

finding.title: Insufficient non-text contrast on auth form input borders
finding.description: Auth inputs use border: 1px solid var(--color-surface-line) (#dddbea) on var(--color-surface) (#ffffff), producing a contrast ratio of ~1.36:1, below the WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast minimum of 3:1 for UI component boundaries.
finding.remediation: Darken the input border token on white surfaces to at least 3:1 contrast against #ffffff (e.g., #767676 or an equivalent indigo-tinted neutral).

finding.title: Fieldsets without legends and unnamed forms
finding.description: <fieldset> elements are used solely to disable controls during aria-busy requests without a <legend> first child. In chat.html, multiple <form> elements on the same page lack accessible names via aria-labelledby or aria-label.
finding.remediation: Add a <legend> (visible or .visually-hidden) as the first child of each <fieldset>, and provide accessible names (aria-labelledby or aria-label) for each <form> on chat.html.

finding.title: Textarea disables resize while relying on Newly Available field-sizing: content
finding.description: The chat composer textarea sets resize: none alongside field-sizing: content (Baseline Newly Available since 2026-06-16, not yet Widely Available). In browsers without field-sizing support, the textarea is locked to rows="2" and cannot be resized by the user.
finding.remediation: Scope resize: none inside @supports (field-sizing: content), or provide a @supports not (field-sizing: content) CSS grid-mirror fallback so users without field-sizing can still resize or auto-grow the composer.

finding.title: Broken keyboard focus order for mobile rooms toggle checkbox
finding.description: On narrow screens, switching between the rooms list and active room relies on a .visually-hidden checkbox placed in the DOM before <aside> and <main>, while its visible <label> ("Rooms") renders inside <main><header>. Keyboard focus therefore lands on the hidden checkbox out of visual order.
finding.remediation: Replace the out-of-order checkbox hack with native <button type="button"> controls placed in their visual locations (with aria-expanded / aria-controls or state toggling in chat.page.ts) and move focus intentionally when switching views on narrow screens.

finding.title: Manage room floating panel uses details + position: absolute instead of Popover API
finding.description: The "Manage room" overlay uses <details> with a position: absolute; z-index: 2 panel. It lacks top-layer promotion, light-dismiss (Escape key or outside click does not close it), and viewport-edge flip resilience.
finding.remediation: Migrate to a trigger <button popovertarget="room-actions-panel"> and <div id="room-actions-panel" popover="auto"> with CSS Anchor Positioning gated behind @supports (position-area: block-end) (or conditional polyfill).

finding.title: Typing indicator lacks live region semantics
finding.description:
The typing status element (

) updates dynamically without role="status" or aria-live="polite", so screen reader users are not notified when participants are typing.
finding.remediation: Add role="status" (or aria-live="polite") to the typing indicator element, debounced appropriately so announcements do not spam assistive technologies.

finding.title: Missing autocorrect="off" on identifier inputs and hints placed below inputs
finding.description: Identifier inputs (name, members, member-name) set autocapitalize="none" and spellcheck="false" but omit autocorrect="off". In sign-up.html, field hints are placed below their inputs where browser autofill popovers can obscure them during editing.
finding.remediation: Add autocorrect="off" to identifier inputs and place field hints above their corresponding inputs in sign-up.html.

finding.title: Missing Forced Colors Mode fallbacks for box-shadow and gradient cues
finding.description: No @media (forced-colors: active) rules are defined. In Windows High Contrast / Forced Colors Mode, the secondary focus ring box-shadow in auth.css and the radial-gradient typing dots in chat.css are stripped.
finding.remediation: Add @media (forced-colors: active) fallbacks using system color keywords (e.g., CanvasText, Highlight) and outline/border-based cues where box-shadow or background gradients convey state.
